completion:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2. Describe any findings that failed to meet safety standards.
3. Provide details on any violations identified during the audit.
4. Include any actions taken to address the safety deficiencies.
5. Specify any corrective measures implemented to ensure compliance.
